A '''battle''' occurred shortly after the [[Destruction of Laakteen Depot|Destruction]] of the [[Laakteen Depot]], in which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] newly-completed [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] fell under attack at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skorrupon/Legends|Skorrupon]] by a task force of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The ''Executor'' completely destroyed the Rebel ships en route to the Rebellion's [[Great Temple/Legends|base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The only survivor was a Rebel [[Vrad Dodonna's scout ship|scout ship]].

The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], fresh from their [[Battle of Daluuj|mission]] at [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]], hyperspaced out in the immediate aftermath of the battle. Luke briefly witnessed a Rebel scout ship nearby, although it disappeared immediately thereafter. The Rebel scout ship was later revealed to have belong to [[Vrad Dodonna]], who was initially believed to have been killed during the battle. Vrad claimed that his ship ended up severely damaged, although Luke suspected that he actually dithered from battle, and then self-inflicted the damage to his ship to cover up his cowardice.
